personal_info.name: Samantha Frazier
personal_info.occupation: Maine Coon cat breeder and shower
personal_info.family_details: Parents who recently moved to Florida

presenting_problem:
I feel like an incapable cook after my parents visited me and did not like my food. This has led to feelings of inadequacy and self-doubt.
These feelings started after my parents' visit last month and have been bothering me since then.
The stress level when the problem first occurred was high as I value my cooking skills and seek validation from my parents.
The problem has progressed to affecting my confidence in cooking and has made me doubt my abilities in other areas as well.
I experience these feelings whenever I cook or think about cooking for others.
I have tried to improve my cooking skills by taking online classes and experimenting with new recipes, but the negative thoughts persist.
reason_seeking_counseling: The incident with my parents made me realize that these feelings of inadequacy were affecting my self-esteem and enjoyment of cooking, leading me to seek counseling.
patterns: black-and-white or polarized thinking / all or nothing thinking
